behavior: Independent principal-owned documents and folders; no Session or Machine binding; root is parent_id=null
Draft and every Session compose surface use PlatformComposerEditor, preserving the existing CM6/native and Vim/IME paths
Directory moves, tabs, desktop palette, trash/restore, recovery history and Markdown export
Drag/copy into Session creates an unsent draft and keeps the source; Undo compares the original target atomically
Session drafts can move out to independent documents only after target synchronization; referenced images retain independent bytes
Dataset-owned IndexedDB outbox precedes HTTP, independent body/metadata clocks preserve conflicts and operation ids deduplicate retries
Versioned editor-extension facade with scoped cleanup, composition/selection fences, built-in templates, outline and statistics; custom templates are device preferences
extension_distribution: Core compiled extensions and user templates. This does not install third-party JS, claim Obsidian plugin compatibility or replace Cowboy signed Plugin lifecycle.

Concurrent writer conflict preserves both documents and opens the recovered local copy
Long Markdown stays viewport-rendered (84390 characters; insertion 79ms in this browser)
Actual Desktop workspace, tabs and toolbar fit 320–1440px at 8–24px fonts; modified browser shortcuts are preserved
Unmount revokes old plugin editor authority and keeps the saved document
